nodes.label: Vite Build and Dev Server Config
nodes.rationale: Dev server proxies /api, /vod, /clips, /exports to the backend over HTTP and /ws, /live over WebSocket so the frontend runs same-origin against a real Frigate. esbuild keepNames is on because runtime code relies on function names. Only the editorWorkerService language worker plus a custom yaml worker are bundled to keep Monaco small.
